name: How can I measure the success of a Generative Engine Optimization strategy for my remodeling business?

mainEntity.name: How can I measure the success of a Generative Engine Optimization strategy for my remodeling business?

acceptedAnswer.text: Measuring GEO success involves tracking several key performance indicators (KPIs). These include increased organic search traffic to your website, higher search engine rankings for target keywords, improved lead generation (e.g., contact form submissions, phone calls), and better conversion rates from visitors to booked appointments or sales. Monitoring engagement metrics like bounce rate and time on page, along with overall ROI on your marketing spend, also provides valuable insights into the strategy's effectiveness.
acceptedAnswer.description: Measure GEO success by tracking organic traffic, search rankings, lead generation, conversion rates, engagement metrics, and overall ROI for your remodeling business.
